basic_info.description: Set atop the Forest Hill neighborhood, this 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath home was extensively remodeled. The home features an open configuration kitchen (Quartz, gas) with bar counter, new stainless appliances and new kitchen cabinets. A skylight provides natural light. The open living room/ dining room configuration embellishes a wood-burning fireplace, new dual pane windows, new floors, recess lighting - all freshly painted inside and out. The upstairs bathroom has been remodeled, complete with a skylight and new finishes. The private, fenced rear yard offers lots of possibilities for gardening, children's play and entertaining. Conveniently within walking distance to Golden Gate Heights Park, Hawk Hill and Herbert Hoover middle school.
